key_insight: Environment Duels evaluates LLMs as both task creators and problem solvers. It turns interactive environments into a small-scale testbed for studying how models challenge and learn from one another.
problem_solved: As LLMs increasingly encounter content generated by other models, evaluation needs to measure not only problem-solving ability but also the ability to create meaningful challenges for other AI systems.
method: Have models generate interactive environments, each paired with a privileged hint.
Evaluate models in both environment-creation and environment-solving roles.
Use these duels to examine model interactions; the supplied abstract is truncated before the full evaluation criteria.
impact: This benchmark could help practitioners evaluate complementary strengths in task generation and agentic problem solving. It offers a framework for investigating model-to-model interactions in synthetic-data and evaluation pipelines.
visual_elements: Two-role loop: an LLM creates an environment, and another LLM attempts to solve it.
Environment card showing a task, interaction interface, and privileged-hint icon.
Ecosystem diagram connecting model-generated content, training pipelines, and future models.
paper_title: Environment Duels: A Microcosm of LLM Co-Evolution
paper_authors: Shibo Jin, Zhiqiu Xu, Yiling Zou, Shangyu Gong, Mayur Naik
